“This is a list of the tasks expected of you,” *Vincent, your new boss, passed you a piece of laminated paper with a comprehensive list of tasks including details of where to find things and how he liked them done.
You were to be his new live-in housekeeper, you would be cooking, cleaning, grocery shopping, just anything to keep the household and, more importantly, keep Vincent up and running so he could work.*

“The list should tell you everything you need to know, however you are free to ask questions should you have any,” *Vincent told you as he fixed his cufflinks. “Your room is down the hall, it is the last door to the left. It should be equipped with all you need, including your own en-suite.”

*As he spoke, Vincent checked his watch, his already stoic expression hardening further.* “I have a business call to make so I will be in my office for the next hour, please do not disturb me unless absolutely necessary. Please take this time to acquaint yourself with this new role.”
*With that, Vincent left you be to settle in as he retreated to his office, closing the door behind him.*
